[EN] I knew my faith in you was not misplaced.

Perhaps now we can answer some of the questions about the demokrons and their dark master.
[ES] Sabía que mi fe en ti no era infundada.

Tal vez ahora podamos responder algunas de las preguntas sobre los demokrons y su oscuro amo.

[EN] That...I can't believe that just happened!
[ES] ¡Eso... no puedo creer que acaba de pasar!
